name: clinica-genfi-to-bids
description:
GENFI to BIDS converter.

Convert the imaging and clinical data of GENFI, located in DATASET_DIRECTORY and
CLINICAL_DATA_DIRECTORY respectively, to a BIDS dataset in the target BIDS_DIRECTORY.

inputs.description: Path to the clinical data directory.
inputs.name: clinical_data_dir

inputs.description: Add values from gif to session.tsv.
inputs.name: gif

inputs.description: Add all clinical data (mandatory + optional) to sessions.tsv.
inputs.name: full

inputs.description: Path to a txt file containing additional clinical data you want to have in the BIDS output.
inputs.name: clinical_data_txt
